name: M&MCore
description: The value-priced sister site of AgenticCore, under the same umbrella and the same AI-run delivery model, with one simplified tier per service and no premium markup. Real prices starting at $32. Sites, branding, marketing and bookkeeping, plus a Starter Package bundling a landing page, a batch of social posts, branded documents and a feasibility + marketing report at one fixed price. Two named verticals on the homepage: social media marketing for real estate agents and brokerages, and an AI trading bot with built-in risk control for Forex and crypto.
audience: Price-sensitive real estate agents and small brokerages, and first-time founders who want something live cheaply. Global, weighted to India, Pakistan and the Gulf where the price point matters most.
goal: Drive signups to the fixed-price starter tiers
tone: direct and unpretentious. Leads with the price and what you get for it. Never apologises for being the cheaper option — treats transparent pricing as the advantage it is.
keywords: social media marketing for real estate agents
forbidden_claims: any guaranteed result, ranking, lead volume or return
any profit, yield or performance claim about the trading bot
named clients, case studies or testimonials — there are none yet
describing the trading bot as advice, signals, or a recommendation to buy or sell
